title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action
abstract: arXiv:2610.00518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter ef

translated_title: 基于训练动力学动作的单步生成建模
translated_abstract: 单步生成模型通过迭代式的训练时传输来构建静态生成器。现有的传输目标主要评估分布运动，然而神经生成器需要通过共享参数更新来联合实现所要求的样本位移。这种训练时的构建方式引出了一个问题：当训练成为构建最终单步映射的迭代过程时，应该优化什么：是下一次的分布移动，还是有限生成器学习最终映射的路径？为了解决这一问题，我们提出了训练动力学动作，它在保持规定水平分布进展的同时，根据局部共享参数实现成本来选择传输目标。我们将该成本表述为一个软终端控制问题，并推导出了闭式解的批量切线动作值，该值考虑了参数效率……
tldr: 本文提出TDAction方法，通过基于局部共享参数实现成本来选择传输目标，在保持规定分布进展水平的同时，优化单步生成模型的训练动态过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TDAction, which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining prescribed distributional progress, thereby optimizing the training dynamics of one-step generative models.
